ДЕТАЛЬНІШИЙ ОПИС:
We are currently searching for 1 European volunteer from Ukraine for our Kindergarten “Storchennest” project in Potsdam. The project will start in 08.01.2018 and will last for 12 months.
Kindergarten “Storchennest”
http://www.lsb-sportservice.de/einrichtungen/kita-am-storchennest.html

The Kindergarten “Storchennest” is a child care institution with the tradition of more than 60 years. The Kindergarten is situated 6 km north of Potsdam Centre in Golm and has the capacity of 60 children aged between 1-6 years, who in their development are accompanied by 7 educators/teachers, movement coordinator and other support persons like trainees and volunteers. The Kindergarten has activity rooms on 2 floors that are occupied based on the themes and age categories of children and a big playground and garden for outdoor activities. The Kindergartens are supervised by LSB Sport Service Brandenburg gGmbH, that was set up in August 2004 as a 100% subsidiary of the Brandenburgische Sportjugend im Landessportbund Brandenburg e.V. (Sports Youth Brandenburg within the Sports Federation Brandenburg). Organization's tasks are the acquisition of Kindergartens and after school care centers and providing them a profile of an exercise and movement oriented institution.
The Kindergarten as the receiving organisation will closely cooperate with the Brandenburgische Sportjugend (http://sportjugend-bb.de/), who is going to act as the coordinator in this project.
ACTIVITIES

The project foresees that through the daily work in the Kindergarten the volunteer gains indepth knowledge about the sport and health oriented Kindergarten concept, which was developed by the Brandenburgische Sportjugend in co-operation with the Potsdam University. A new concept plans to fight motorial and development deficits at early child stage. "On the move" education has the highest priority as a pedagogical basic principle and therefore the slogan of the Kindergarten is ‘Always on the move’. The concept nowadays is considered to be an example of best practice in the Federal State of Brandenburg.

Through the daily engagement volunteer will be integrated in the "on the move and health orientated" program ofthe Kindergarten. Volunteer will support the staff/pedagogues in the Kindergarten during their service, making games, sports, various workshops and fun parts of the daily occupations of children. Movement activities will help the children to activate the reduced actions to move their body, as well as, help opposing their impoverished actions during leisure time activities. In addition, the volunteers should communicate to the children that doing sports and being active is fun. In this way this approach will lead the children to a better consciousness for health.

The volunteer should be of assistance to all kinds of activities and help the pedagogues in their daily work. Movement and health themes are only one part of activities offered in the Kindergarten. The Kindergarten offers for children activities, workshops and projects in the direction of handicrafts, music, environmental awareness, geography etc.

Also, the volunteer will have opportunity after agreement with the Receiving organisation to organize his/her own projects, e.g. about himself/herself, his/her own country, culture, traditions, language and food. The volunteer can bring in own songs, dances and games.
Kindergarten can offer the following work and learning opportunities to the volunteer:
- to learn and reflect about on-movement - and health orientated lifestyle in Kindergarten
- to learn and reflect about the work and educational activities in the Kindergarten
- to learn about sport structure and organizations in Germany
- learn about the educational and pedagogic methods
- to plan and implement the festivities and celebrations
- teamwork
- to learn German language
- to receive the knowledge about German culture
- to develop values
- develop social competencies, personality andcreativity
Background and profile of participant:
- interested in work with young children
- interested in sport orientated work in the Kindergarten
- interested in the organisation and implementation of sport orientated events and projects
with children
- dedicated commitment and creativity (for example skills in music, sport and games, dance or in general be familiar with games with children)
- awareness of being the role model for children
- sociable, friendly, patient and open-minded
- willing to learn new skills
- curious and be interested in German culture and language
- body hygiene.

title: Нова сторінка в еко-спрямованих проектах на базі еко-центру в Стіні

data.text: [українська версія внизу]
Нова сторінка в еко-спрямованих проектах на базі еко-центру в Стіні: 10-14 липня відбувся новий табір.
Після табору в червні, що мав на меті побудову міжкультурного діалогу, розробку аудіо-візуального матеріалу та презентації села у Вінниці, ми вирішили повернутись щоб продовжувати роботу!

Ми хотіли попрацювати із будинком та його територією але ще і організувати культурні події. Місцеві жителі надали нам велику допомогу, забезпечили інструментами, були з нами та інструктували. Ми бачимо, що ми побудували справді довірливі стосунки обміну та дружби. Ми запрошували людей їсти до нас, а вони взамін - до себе. Це були цінні моменти спілкування! Я, навіть, ходив в поле із місцевим Миколою, який нам значно допоміг, аби збирати сіно перед дощем!
Також ми прийняли та показали село журналістам телеканалу "Україна", які створили гарну картинку села для національного глядача.

Підсумовуючи роботу, ми вирівняли територію навколо хати, майже закінчили роботу із вікнами, прибрали, побудували зовнішні пічку та душ, провели англійський клуб, але найбільше, що досягнули, - побудували дружбу та міжкультурний діалог! Буде продовження...
ЄВС волонтер "Нашого Поділля" - Ремі Прієр

data.text: Привіт, мене звати Артур Гончаров І я волонтер програми ERASMUS+ у Вроцлаві. Мій проект полягає у допомозі в Центрі по догляду за людьми з обмеженими інтелектуальними здібностями. Це мій перший досвід у цій сфері І я дуже хвилювався перед тим, як розпочав свій проект. Однак, все склалося дуже добре. Якщо ти маєш мотивацію, гарний настрій І відкриваєшся для чогось нового - в тебе все складеться! Саме з такою внутрішньою настановою я долаю дрібні (а часом І дуже великі) перешкоди І проблеми. Звичайно, їх не уникнути, але без них ти не здобудеш найважливішого - перемог І досвіду.

Робота у Центрі вимагає міцного терпіння, обсервування, вміння адаптуватись І стресостійкості. На початку було складно, деякі учасники Центру відверто викликали страх, але з часом І допомогою працівників все змінилось. Я навчився шукати І знаходити правильний піхід до різних учасників, адже кожний з них унікальний І достукатися до кожного - велика справа. Але коли тобі це вдасться ти отримаєш у відповідь невимовне задоволення: кожна посмішка, дрібний подарунок, зроблений власними руками, подаровані тобі учасником - безцінні. Тут ти можеш навчитися бачити світ навколо себе іншим, цінувати життя, радіти І помилятися, а найважливіше - щирості.

Вроцлав, як на мене, найкраще місто у Польщі. В минулому році - Європейська столиця культури, а у 2017 - місто-господар Світових Ігр. В це місто не можливо не закохатися, воно дихає разом з тобою, пропускаючи повітря крізь сотні мостів, артеріями Одри. Тут можна знайти все: найвищу будівлю у Польщі, найсмачніше морозиво І пончики, більше 200 фігурок гномів, захованих у найнеочікуваніших місцях, найкрасивіше Старе місто І найцінніше - себе. Раджу всім відвідати Вроцлав, впевнений, він залишиться у ваших спогадах назавжди!

Волонтерство з ERASMUS+ стало для мене періодом злетів І падінь, нових знайомств, нових знань, нових можливостей ! Я щасливий, що мені вдалось потрапити на цей проект. Цим я завдячую ГО "Пангея Ультіма". Навіть на відстані в тисячу кілометрів я завжди знаю, що можу покластися на команду організації і завжди відчуваю, що не сам. Величезне дякую за це!
А всім, хто вагається, хочу порадити відкинути всі сумління І сміливо приймати участь у проекті - воно того, повірте, варте!

Головною метою тренінгу було підготувати вуличну акцію та поділитися своїм досвідом про участь у волонтерському проекті, висвітлити нашу мотивацію до волонтерської діяльності. Під час тренінгу ми втілили ідею на практиці та провели у центрі м. Ганновер вуличну акцію під гаслом “Формуємо Європу разом!”, інформуючи молодь про можливості прийняття участі у волонтерських проектах, спонукаючи кожного робити свій внесок у зміцнення міжкультурних зв’язків і взаєморозуміння між народами та країнами.

Наша група виготовила з паперу пташки орігамі та проводила опитування у центрі міста. Ми спілкувалися з людьми, беручи у них інтерв’ю по закінченню якого вони досить творчо виражали свої побажання щодо того якою вони хотіли б бачити Європу. Тому було дуже багато цікавих дискусій, домок і вражень.

Все почалося з побажання миру. Так дівчина намалювала голуба, який символізує мир і є символом щастя. Таким чином кожна людина яку ми зустрічали залишала на папері свої побажання у вигляді малюнку, певного знаку чи слів.

Ми були задоволені результатами нашої роботи, так як мали можливість спілкуватися з різними людьми, молоддю, донести до них важливу інформацію, обмінятися думками та поділитися враженнями з іншими групами нашої великої команди, що була задіяна у тренінгу та проводила подібні акції.

title: We have rights, now let's be humans YE in Georgia

data.text: 5 young Ukrainians, members and friends of Development Center “Pangeya Ultima” participated in Erasmus+ Youth Exchange “We have rights, now let’s be human”. The project took place from 26/07/2017 to 03/08/2017 in Rustavi, Georgia. There were participants from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Former Yugoslav Republic of Macedonia, Georgia, Italy, Malta and Romania.
Ukrainian team in the cultural evening.
The aim of the objectives of the project were:
increasing the level of awareness about the refugee crisis;
development tolerant attitudes toward interculturality;
raising the level of knowledge and understanding about the human rights and refugees’ rights;
facilitating a context for intercultural dialogue and communication.

‘It was my first time in such project. And I've never mention that I can get soo great life experience. Because no one university or school can’t give you this possibility - to be yourself! Want it more!’ – Mariia Androshchuk.

‘It was very cool meeting! 40 people from 8 countries, different cultures, colors of skin, religions. I felt everyone must be here. Thanks to everyone for that! I love you, humanity.’ – Volodymyr Kuchma
‘Thank you for great leadership experience. It was my honor to be a leader of Ukrainian team in Youth Exchange.’ – Iryna Kotyk

During that project young people discussed about human rights, participated in workshops, world café, human library, performed forum and shadow theatres about human rights discrimination, met with IDPs from Abkhazia and South Ossetia, conquered Georgian mountains, organized live exhibition in the city center to promote Erasmus program and human rights for local people.
Thank you, DC “Pangeya Ultima”, for that opportunity.

data.text: EVS in Ostoja (Stowarzyszenie Pomocy Dzieciom i Młodzieży) 2017-18
WHERE: Dolnośląskie Stowarzyszenie Pomocy Dzieciom i Młodzieży z MPDz Ostoja
CITY: Wrocław/Poland (capital of Lower Silesia region, 632 430 inhabitants)
Info about Receiving Organization – OSTOJA

Wroclaw is the capital of the Lower Silesian region and one of the biggest cities in Poland with the population of about 750 000. It is situated in the south-western part of Poland, not far from the German and Czech borders. The big part of the region, south from Wroclaw are mountainous areas, many of them being polish favorite holiday destinations. The Lower Silesia region was Polish, Czech, Austro-Hungarian and German and at different points of its history and therefore its cultural and historic heritage is multicultural and very impressive. Wrocław itself is a beautiful city with many historic sites and very friendly atmosphere. It is a lively academic town and hosts many cultural and arts festivals. Our Association's centers are spread around Wroclaw and in SrodaSlaska. The transport links are excellent, and many important points are within walking distance. It is accessible for wheelchairs and easy to get to, because these are the basic criteria for our clients.

For last 10 years we used to host around 40 EVS volunteers and 10 from Grundvig project from different European countries. The profile of the EVS volunteers was always different - starting from very young and unexperienced persons, ending up on young professionals graduated of social studies. All of them found their comfortable place to work, and had a lot of satisfaction. The two advantages of our placement are: 1) our professional staff is always there, ready for help in any case, 2) a young volunteer can feel really needed, can feel sense of dedicating part of her/his energy for people who need them so much. And they receive a lot in return- people's smile, closeness and friendship.

Our organization consists of several centers, each of them has its own profile: The Rehabilitation-Educative Centre for Children with Cerebral Palsy.The clients of this center are deeply disabled children, majority with Children Brain Paralysis, a lot of them don’t speak, don’t walk, and have very limited contact with the outside world. The proposed therapy there are: physiotherapy, speech lessons therapy, room of the world experience, pedagogy therapy etc. There are circa 60 children, aged 3-25. They work mostly with 3-5 children and 2 professionals (special educator, protector for help) in 1 group. The place is open from 8 a.m.-2 p.m. (common room 2 p.m.-4 p.m.)

Youth rehabilitation - therapy center. The afternoon occupation for youth disabled working or practicing people. Also for youth with less disability who couldn’t get place in Workshop of Occupational Therapy. This place is also for wheel-chair group.The place is open from 3 p.m. till 6 p.m., for people 20-40 years old, circa 70 persons.Different skills and interests can be developed here: sports, artistic (art-therapy, ceramic, movie group) cultural activities, communication skills, also work support and psychologist support. Within the activities the groups visit different exhibitions, movie, theater etc.

KLEKS. This center belongs to Youth Rehabilitation -Therapy Centre (kind of common room/ club for youth).There are 15 participants, aged 25-40 less and moderately disabled. The center is open from 8 a.m. till 2 p.m., the clients can come between 8 a.m. and 1 p.m., from 2 p.m. till 4 p.m. there is individual work with deeply disabled persons. There are 3 therapists, who work here permanently. Each day in the week is connecting with practicing one activity, for example Monday-educational day, Tuesday- workshop(artistic) day, Wednesday - music therapy, Thursday-reeducation, Friday – cooking&cleaning day. Every day from 8-9 they have gymnastic.

Workshop of Occupational Therapy. It's one of the biggest in the Poland. In this place they prepare disabled people to participate in aid employment, practicing how to be independent in their own life, exercising some life and personal skills. Some of the participants are making job practice during attending the center (e.g. cleaning, making salads in the fast-food shops). There are 100 participants, aged 19-55, moderately and deeply intellectual disabled, also mental, with autism and cerebral palsy. The workshop is open between 7.30 a.m. and 3.30 p.m. There are 13 workshop groups: nature; cleaning; preparation for the job (aid employment), computer usage; digitizingdocuments; photography; household; art-therapy; ceramic; manufacture (artistic handy-craft); music; wooden craft; personal skills training. There is also gymnastic obligatory for everybody and also jogging group 3 times per week, also another activities like English lessons, dances leaded by volunteers.Some groups have 5 people+1 therapist, another 10 part.+2 therapists. Personnel working here: 20 therapists, 2 psychologists, physiotherapists, speech-therapists, re-educator, nurse, 2 managers. Activities, which are lead here: different projects, camps, participating and organizing art festivals and sport events, trips, visiting exhibitions, movie, theater etc.

Small workshop in small city, 30 km from Wroclaw, belonging to OSTOJA. This center doesn't have experience with hosting EVS volunteers yet (they have only local), but they want start to join in EVS project. In this place they also prepare disabled people to participate in aid employment, practicing how to be independent in their own life, exercising some life and personal skills.There are 30 participants, aged 25-50,less and moderately disabled, intellectual, mental also with autism and cerebral palsy. The workshop is open between 7.30 a.m. and 3.30 p.m. There are 5 workshop groups: computer&integration with European Union, nature&cleaning group, household, re-education&social skills, art-therapy. To this place volunteers have to go by suburban buses from Wroclaw, but it's not so complicated, takes circa 45 min. from Railway Station to center of ŚrodaŚląska.
Role of EVS volunteers in the host organization

The first weeks after arriving will be entirely dedicated to introduction training on how to work with an intellectually retarded people and also the time to go and see all centers belonging to OSTOJA Association. There is official volunteers’ coordinator in our association responsible for taking care of volunteers throughout the entire term of a project.

Volunteers will help therapists during activities working in team or individually with one participant who has difficulty to fulfil the tasks. Depends on different profiles of ours centers part of the tasks should be also to help by dressing, feeding, cleaning during the workshops etc.The choice activities they will perform will be left to the volunteer's interests.

Due to challenging target group, volunteer, in consultation with coordinator will always choose freely the activities she/he would like to assist or perform. Volunteer will never stay alone with the group. After some time, when volunteer will get involved into the therapeutic work and know Polish language enough, she/he can carry out their own ideas and small project(for ex. dance workshop, English classes) with the participants. A young volunteer can not only learn about cerebral palsy therapy and methods, but first of all learn about himself, her/his limits, possibilities and predispositions. The volunteers will participate in many cultural, sports and others outdoor events with our participants.

During the summer time volunteers can go with us for SLOT Art Festival where we participate every year, also join summer camps we organize in different parts of Poland (for ex. in the mountains and at lakes). This will also be an excellent opportunity for volunteers to see and experience Polish holiday resorts. We also greatly encourage our volunteers that they sometimes meet with our clients and workers outside work, so they could feel that they are friends. To avoid language gap we will encourage volunteers to master basic everyday Polish after arrival with coordinator and therapists from the center. There are ten Polish volunteers working in the centers.

The EVS volunteer besides working together with them will be expected to organize some informal meetings in which they would exchange experiences with working with mentally disabled youth in different countries and learn from one another. Naturally volunteers are encouraged to dedicate some of their spare time to plan and prepare their own activities, with help of professionals. Especially welcome by the group members is to make a presentation about their country, to cook traditional meals, teach a national song or dance or something else which will surely be very interesting for the viewers. Every own idea is welcome!
As each of the center has its own profile, so the activities, proposed for volunteers could be also different.

At The Rehabilitation-Educative Centre for Children with Deep Intellectual Handicap they work with hard disabled children, so the work there is connected with help the special educators with their feeding, dressing, helping to move, stimulating the kids etc. (it's mostly physical work).

At Workshop of Occupational Therapy and Youth Rehabilitation-Therapy Center the volunteer will help therapists, work in groups or individually with more disable persons, going outside with group, teaching English or dance or... - own ideas are welcome. Also going with participants to camps, trips, taking part in artistic festivals and projects.

ЄВС волонтер проекту YouthInsight 2016-17 Едоардо Скоччіоліні (Італія) у своїй презентації намагався показати, що сьогодні значить українська ідентичність, належність до цієї країни і які саме фактори пов'язують людей разом під одним прапором.

Проект "Дзеркало України" показує як українці описують свою країну і як вони бачать себе крізь очі іноземців. Було можливим порівняти образи, якими українці описують свою землю та ті, які вони вважають іноземці мають про Україну. В цьому випадку поставали страхи та привиди, що переслідують людей.
Завдячуючи декільком інтерв'ю та активним дискусіям стало можливим дослідити коріння української культури і поділитись різними думками про шляхи розвитку, які країна обрала зараз.

EVS volunteer of the Youthinsight 2016-17 project Edoardo Scocciolini (Italy) through his presentation tried to show what nowdays means Ukrainian identity, belonging to this country and which are the factors that bind people under the same flag.

The project "Mirror of Ukraine" shows how ukrainians describe their country and how they see themselves through foreigner's eyes. It was possible to compare the picture that ukrainians give to their land and the one that they suppose foreigners have, in this case was also a chance to show the fears and the ghosts that people see behind them.

Thanks to several interviews and a prolific debate it was possible to explore the roots of the Ukrainian culture and share different points of views about the directions that the country has taken so far.

title: "Open your eyes in an open space" EVS in Lithuania by Yarik, Mary & Myrik

data.text: 2 months of our EVS project has already passed. It was very saturated and eventful time. Antaliepte is the village where we live, work and learn. During these two months we have witnessed a variety of events – youth exchanges, summer camps, workcamps, social entrepreneurship festival, conferences and so on.

We prepared the territory for sleeping, helped with food serving, partly participated in events themselves trying to be the part of them and did lots of maintenance stuff. Mary organized self-development clubs for the local kids and a quest around the village during the village festival.

We also had language lessons, it’s not that easy to learn a new language especially Lithuanian where the words sound totally different from Ukrainian except of swear words ;) Though if there’s a good motivation then it seems easier, especially with a nice teacher and children books.

Those two months were full of new discoveries and exploration. Our family travelled to different places. We’ve been so far to Vilnius, Kaunas, Trakai, Latvia (Riga, Jurmala, Daugavpils), Estonia (Tallinn), Finland (Helsinki) and discovered the closest vicinity.

We had a plenty of beautiful moments both in Antaliepte, swinging high on a huge swing feeling the wind in the hair, observing horizon and painting the Wheel of Happiness, and watching the ships sailing from the sea beach of Tallinn and drinking hot cocoa with a most delicious patty in the old town.

We rode bikes, met different nationalities, broomed the monastery, washed the floors, tried new cuisines, met the deers and wild boars on the way to the other village, Yaroslav had driving, fixing and drilling practice.

We swam in cold Baltic sea and ate in one of the most expensive restaurants in the centre of Helsinki with the most hospitable counselor of Finland in Ukraine. We danced at one of the youth exchanges and tasted 10 kinds of jam made by locals as well as honey just made by the bees. Many creative people on the one hand and many drunk locals on the other but definitely not aggressive.
Hardships, discomforts, rain, sadness and sunshine, smiles, new feelings, family reunion. We experience all kinds of emotions that help us make our life more valuable and meaningful.

Резюме (англійською) відсилайте сюди: pangeya.ultima.dc@gmail.com до 22.09.2017
EVS Eastern Express in Blagoevgrad, Bulgaria (2017-2018)
Project title:3E: EVS Eastern Express
Venue:Blagoevgrad, Bulgaria
Duration: starting 1 December 2017 for 12 months
Deadline for sending CV and motivation letter: 22/09/2017

Hosting organization: Active Bulgarian Society /ABS/ mainly focuses on cooperation with Bulgarian and foreign youth organizations to exchange experience in the field of sustainable development, education, culture, youth issues in the context of Euro-integration process, promote dialogue between young people from EU member states and candidate countries. We work in the field of mobility learning such as organizing and being partners in many training courses, youth exchanges, eco and volunteer initiatives, active European citizenship activities, sport, cultural, social, seminars, conferences. Since 2016 we are Eurodesk Multiplier for our region. This helps us to inform, guide and empower young people from our region to participate in learning mobility programmes and encourage them to become active citizens. ABS has large experience with organizing eco-initiatives, volunteer campaigns, debates on topical issues, happenings, flash mobs, training courses, intercultural dialogue projects and other events where we try to foster interest and active participation of young people and youth workers from our region.
PROJECT DESCRIPTION

"3E: EVS Eastern Express" foresees participation of 3 volunteers from Moldova, Georgia and Ukraine in 12-months project hosted by Active Bulgarian Society /ABS/ in Blagoevgrad and Sofia, Bulgaria. The main "3EVS" idea is to give an opportunity to 3 young people with economic and educational obstacles from the partner countries to enter their path of social development, both personal and professional and in the same time to contribute to the reinforcement of cultural dialogue, youth policy and European awareness in the area of Blagoevgrad and Sofia.

The relationship of the Union with Ukraine, Republic of Moldova and Georgia is guided by the new Association Agreements, including Deep and Comprehensive Free Trade Areas - the Association agenda states that one of the priorities of EU is to ensure assessment of fundamental rights and "encourage a strategic approach to youth policy and improve exchanges and cooperation in the field of non-formal education for young people and youth workers, as a means of promoting intercultural dialogue and supporting civil society, including through EU programmes in the youth field". "3E: EVS Eastern Express" aims to empower young people from Moldova, Ukraine and Georgia to learn from Union practices in the field of youth work and than apply the knowledge received to the youth field back home thus promoting European values and cooperation and non-formal education among their peers. Following Erasmus+ programme objectives, the project equity and inclusion by offering voluntary placement to people with fewer opportunities, in particular supporting young people with economical and educational obstacles and thus also at long term perspective contribute to their employability potential and overall sense of well-being thanks to equipping them with transversal skills. Thus "3EVS" specific objectives are:

-to give opportunity to 3 young people with fewer opportunities from partner countries to benefit from long term voluntary service throughout which they will gain new skills and competences in the field of youth work and communication;
-to promote active participation, intercultural dialogue, European citizenship and Erasmus+ in Bulgaria and partner countries;

-to help with the professional orientation of the young people in Europe - create an enabling learning environment that will allow volunteers to obtain new or foster existing transversal skills, in order to increase their chances to find a job;
-to boost the skills of young people for self-actualization and self-realization in the labor market;

-to ensure capacity building in the field of EVS project management, transfer of knowledge and best practice sharing among the consortium and as a long term result to empower collaboration with EU partner countries;
-to encourage the active participation of young people in public life and to inspire them to act as multipliers of the new knowledge and skills in their local communities;

-to provide our volunteers with competences in non-formal and informal education and training (during the voluntary service they will develop practical skills for working with groups - facilitating group processes, discussions, debates, trainings, public speaking, management of youth projects and many others).
MAIN ACTIVITIES

Among activities offered to the volunteers are: support ABS communication channels including social media and communication with international partners, supporting organizations of international mobility activities such as trainings and youth exchanges, providing information about Erasmus+ and learning mobility to the local youth, organizing local social events / e.g. chat clubs/, language tandems and other interactive activities for young people, working with Eurodesk database and many others.

Each volunteer will be encouraged to propose own personal project idea, an activity that shall be beneficial both for the target group ABS is working on the daily basis and for the volunteer(s) themselves in terms of learning objectives. The main methodology used throughout the project is dialogue and problem-based learning, learning by doing and direct engagement in activities. As a result, all three volunteers will develop a greater awareness of European citizenship and various transversal skills including such as digital skills, sense of initiative and entrepreneurship, social skills and international communication, management and presentation skills and others. They will also develop various skills they can use in the labor market such as knowledge of methods of non-formal learning; knowledge on how an organization is organized; ability to work in a multicultural team. All this will have direct impact on volunteers’ employability.

On the local level the project will impact young people who are direct target group of ABS - they will benefit from volunteers' engagement in youth work, their ideas and commitment, intercultural dialogue.

Volunteers’ work will include supporting our daily office activities like answering emails, contacting with partners, supporting all our projects and initiatives, providing information to the local community about the EVS and Erasmus+ programs, holding presentations visiting every month the universities and schools in the region. We are also Eurodesk multiplier, so the future volunteers will have the opportunity to explore the Eurodesk online database and provide information to local youth who are interested. We would like to share our experience with non-formal education and to equip the volunteers with all the necessary tools in order to provide professional career orientation for better social and professional integration. Also, each week the volunteers will have the chance to organize their own art/eco club, where they could present their nation, language, traditions, customs etc. Also, if there are interested people in our city, the volunteers can organize a free language course as a social initiative to the local community. Moreover, they can start helping school students who had difficulties with foreign language or organize language Tandem events. We will encourage and support volunteers with realization of their own ideas that fit our organization’s policy and priorities.

Conditions: The volunteers will be hosted in shared rooms with another volunteer/ from the same sex/ in their own flat with bathroom, terrace and kitchen, fully furnished with all the necessary kitchen utensils. The volunteers will be engaged in activities 30 -35 working hours a week according to the programme guide.

Mentor: The coordinating organization provides the volunteer with a mentor’s support who will help the volunteer set learning goals and together they may evaluate them after the project has finished. Also, the mentor can help the volunteer with emergency situations, such as going to the doctor, or orientation and information about the local life and all events happening.

Language support: Even though the working language is English, still each volunteer will have the opportunity to attend a Bulgarian language course. Language support will be arranged by coordinating institution. Course will be held by professional Bulgarian as a foreign language teacher. As a coordinating organization, we will provide other opportunities to practice Bulgarian (tandem meetings, etc.). Moreover, our team will assist the learning process of each volunteer.

Volunteers’ profile: 18-30 years old, unemployed, finished or excluded of the formal education system, or with economical difficulties. The most important criteria in the selection process would be the motivation, communication level of English language skills, and basic computer skills. Last but not least, the volunteers would have the opportunity to develop their own project under our supervision and with our support, on a topic related with our reality and for our community, e.g. a YE, TC, etc.

If you are interested to participate in the project, send us your CV and motivation letter why you want to become a volunteer by 22/09/2017 the latest. Should you have any questions please don’t hesitate to address them via email to: p angeya.ultima.dc@gmail.com
You can find more information from the articles of our current and past EVS volunteers on our website in the section Stories: https://www.activebulgariansociety.org/blog

title: ЄВС "SDS in Brzeg Dolny" Катерини Репецької добіг кінця

data.text: Мій EVS рік добіг кінця і я вже сумую за всіма людьми з якими встигла познайомитися. Такий обмін – це прекрасна альтернатива для людей, які не впевнені у власному виборі життєвого шляху, стоять на розпутті, або хочуть визначитися з професією, адже це так прекрасно розвиватися у новому місці та мати можливість спробувати себе у різних напрямках, зрозуміти, що тобі цікаво, дізнаватися щось нове про різні країни світу, подорожувати та знаходити нових друзів.

Я буду сумувати за моєю роботою, адже колектив у який я потрапила казковий. Вони з перших днів допомагали мені адаптуватися, підтримувати та наснажували. Такої підтримки я не отримувала на жодному робочому місці. За моїми учасниками, з ними було так весело: танці, караоке, спорт, ігри та звісно ж наші заняття, наші спільні виїзди, знайомство з іншими організаціями та їх учасниками та спільні веселощі.
Працювати з особами неповносправними – це не легко і можливо така праця не для кожного, але я була в захваті, мала можливість навчитися підходам до такої праці а Польщі.
Катерина Репецька, учасник проекту Європейської Волонтерсьої Служби програми Ерасмус Плюс.

Ось і покрокував проект Image Mapping за межі України і продовжився акцією в селі Antaliepte, округ Utena, що на півночі Литви. Це місце біло обрано завдяки співпраці членів ГО "ЦР Пангея Ультіма" із Innovator’s Valley (започатковано NISI - Національний Інститут Соціальної Інтеграції), що розвиває ідеї соціального підприємництва та різноманітні соціальні та еко-спрямовані інновації в цьому місці.

Про Antaliepte можна розповідати багато. Перш за все це село знаходиться в одному із найбільш живописних місць Литви, в межах регіонального природного парку Grazutes, що перекладається як "Краса". Ландшафт околиць неспецифічний для рівнинної Литви - тут протікає єдина кам'яниста річка цієї країни Savasa і зливається із іншою річкою Sventoja, а також довкола багато пагорбів та хвилястостей, порослих свіжим та різнолистовим лісом. Savasa створила живописні лісові каньйони, улюблені місця проживання бобрів. Назва ж поселення походить від чисельності невеличких мостиків, що перетинають струмки та річечки в долині села. Водосховище під назвою "Море Antaliepte", котре утворилось після побудови гідроелектростанції, вважається однією із найповноводніших систем озер у Литві.

В Antaliepte і околицях дуже затишно і ці місця приваблювали поселятись людей ще з давніх часів. Поблизу Antaliepte, в лісі можна знайти капище язичників, від якого так і відбиває енергією. Найактивніша ж частина історії поселення припадає на XVIII-XIX століття. Зокрема тут започатковується монастир західно-європейського ордену Босих кармелітів, будується католицький собор. Після переходу Литви під вплив Російської Імперії ці об'єкти стають православними, а за радянських часів монастир втрачає своє релігійне значення і виконує різноманітні - від освітніх до складських ролей.

Innovator's Valley працює саме із об'єктами, що належали монастирю і наділяє їм нового сенсу і вдихаючи нове життя в них - організовує тут освітні, соціальні та культурні заходи, реалізовує молодіжні програми. Innovator's Valley, як в принципі, і село Antaliepte можна вважати цікавим напрямком для краєзнавчого туризму, тому наш проект Image Mapping і взявся за популяризацію та підкреслення особливих місць, котрі варто відвідати туристам тут в першу чергу. Серед створених "Живих картин" в основному об'єкти території, де працює Innovator's Valley, та де діяв монастир Босих Кармелітів.

Влітку-восени 2017 року Innovator's Valley та місцева громада стала партнерами в реалізації третьої точкової акції Image Mapping (не враховуючи Анімаційний табір в селі Стіна). Дякуємо всім партнерам.
N.B.: Точки ще не завершені - чекаємо на інформаційні таблички.
[English version below]

The Image Mapping project has stepped over the border of Ukraine and was continued with an action in the Antaliepte village, Utena region that is on the far north of Lithuania. This place was chosen thanks to the cooperation of the DC Pangeya Ultima members with the "Innovator's Valley" (founded by the NISI - National Institute of Social Integration) that promotes ideas of social entrepreneurship and different social and ecologically tailored innovations in this place.

About Antaliepte can be said a lot. First of all this village is located within one of the most picturesque places in Lithuania - inside the natural regional park "Grazutes", which is literally translated as "The Beauty". The landscape here is non-specific for the predominantly plain Lithuania, here as well flows the single for this country rocky river Savasa and merges with another river Sventoja. As well around the village are a lot of hills and land-waves overgrown with fresh and diverse forests. Savasa has created picturesque wood canyons, favorite dwelling places of beavers. The name of Antaliepte derives from the high quantity of small bridges that cross springs and rivers in the village valley. The water-basin that was created as a result of the hydro-electrical station set up bearing the name "The sea of Antaliepte" is considered one of the most voluminous lake systems in whole Lithuania.

In Antaliepte and its vicinities is very cozy and these places have attracted people from early times. Nearby Antaliepte in the forest a pagan shrine can be found that literally emanates energy. The most active part of the Antaliepte settlement comes at the XVIII-XIX centuries. In particular a monastery of the western-European order of Barefoot Carmelites was founded here at the time, a catholic cathedral was erected. After the passage of Lithuania under the influence of the Russian empire these objects become Orthodox and during the Soviet times the monastery loses its religious purpose and fulfils others - from educational to storage.

Innovator's valley engages exactly the objects that were in the domain of the monastery and confers to them the new meaning and inhales new life in them. Different educational, social and cultural events are held here, youth programmes are realized. Innovator's valley together with the Antaliepte village can be referred as an interesting destination for the countryside tourism, that is why our project Image Mapping has taken up the mission to popularize and underline the remarkable places that should be of a prime attention to the incoming tourists. Among the created "Alive pictures" dominate the sites on the territory where the Valley operates and where the Barefoot Carmelites monastery was established long ago.

In summer-autumn 2017 the Innovator's Valley and the local community became the partners in realization of the third on-site action of the Image Mapping project (not accounting the Animating camp in Stina). We are grateful to all of the partners.

Статтю про проект Image Mapping опубліковано у часописі Всеукраїнської мережі фахівців і практиків з регіонального та місцевого розвитку РЕГІОНЕТ "Стратегія розвитку". Щиро вдячні редакції за обрання нашого матеріалу та особисто Олександру Дудка, який прийняв участь у конференції проекту Image Mapping навесні 2017. Вважаємо, що наш проектний концепт є цікавим для впровадження у малих громадах, де розвивається сільський туризм.

title: "Write. Record. Promote" ЄВС проект в Маріборі (Словенія) / Яна Волович

data.text: Я волонтер в Словении, г. Марибор. Моя миссия в проекте – снимать промо ролики для хостелов моей организации. Таким образом я побывала во многих городах. В целом я рада, что решила приехать сюда, поскольку я очень много путешествую, ведь Словения очень маленькая, и чтобы попасть в другую страну не нужно очень много времени. Кроме того, мне повезло с начальником. Благодаря ему я объездила еще и Италию. Но это отдельная история.
Сам город меня не очень расположил, так как вечером на улице почти никого не встретишь, да и в целом город маленький (особенно после Киева, где всегда и везде толпы народа).

Вообще, я рекомендую участвовать в волонтерском проекте в более юном возрасте. Например, меня в Мариборе окружают в основном студенты, а это 18-23 года. Сами понимаете, интересы разные. Поэтому здесь мне бывает довольно одиноко. Да и поселили меня в о общежитие, где соответственно обитают в основном студенты. Хотя я знаю, что большинство волонтеров живут в квартирах…Мой совет – сразу оговаривайте, где вы будете жить.

Первые 3 месяца моего пребывания в Мариборе мне было очень скучно. Моя организация, как оказалось, назвала это периодом адаптации. Конечно, нужно сделать им скидку на то, что я их первый волонтер, и опыта в таком деле у них не было… Опять же мой совет: загружайте себя сами, если делать вам особенно нечего, иначе потеряете всякую мотивацию… Большой плюс в том, что организация поддержки волонтеров 2раза в год устраивает слеты волонтеров и там мы можем поделиться опытом и решить какие-то проблемы. Это дает и моральную поддержку.

Что касается языка, то для русского человека словенский несложный…НО! Если прилагать усилия в его изучении. Я особо не прилагаю, везде использую английский. Но Словения не Италия. Здесь им многие владеют.

Еще я заметила, что здесь какой-то БУМ танца свинг. Я хотела заняться какими-нибудь танцами, что-то вроде хип-хопа, но поняла, что надо попробовать свинг. Так сказать решила поплыть по течению. Ведь тут постоянно устраиваются свинг вечера и на курсы можно записаться (тогда двое моих знакомых оказывается уже их посещали). Не знаю как в вашем городе, но не в Украине, не в России я не встречала такой популярности свинга. В общем, это меня немного и спасло, ведь там собирались как раз люди постарше.

Кстати, по поводу денег. Я побаивалась, когда собиралась приехать сюда, что их будет не хватать. Но того, что мне выдают на еду и карманные расходы, меня вполне устраивает. В Мариборе цены невысокие, на путешествия скопить можно. Но стоит отметить, что если вы не хотите готовить и предпочитаете питаться в кафе, этих денег вам вряд ли хватит…

В целом, от волонтеров я слышу довольно разные мнения по поводу их волонтерства. Кому-то надоедает уже через полгода, кто-то в восхищении и не хочет уезжать, кто-то просто всем доволен, и тем, что был здесь, и тем, что скоро уезжает домой. Я не жалею, что решила «поволонтерить». Здесь действительно есть возможность куда-то ездить каждые выходные. Да и опыт работы с видео прямо связан с тем, чем я занималась раньше (журналистика). Поэтому, мне кажется, главное – это ваш настрой и ваше умение быть открытым новым людям. Доброжелательность и коммуникабельность вам очень пригодятся.
ЕВС волонтери у Львові

Ніколаус, Фредеріка і Фабіо відвідали Львів для участі у тренінгу 'По прибуттю (On-Arrival). Разом з 18 волонтерами EVS з України, Молдови та Білорусі вони отримали цінну інформацію, яка допоможе їм у їхній щоденній роботі в Вінниці.
Вони навчилися планувати свої проекти, отримали важливу інформацію про приймаючі їх країни. І навчилися ефективно взаємодіяти.
[English below]

Nikolaus, Fabio and Friederike visited Lviv to attend the On-Arrival Training. Together with 18 other EVS volunteers from Ukraine, Moldova and Belarus they got usefull informations that should help them in their daily work in Vinnytsia.
They learned about how to plan their own projects, got important informations about their host countries and how to built an efficient network amongst each other.

#PangeyaUltima прийняла участь візит молоді Вінниччини у Сьвєнтокшиське воєводство Республіки Польща в рамках «Сьвєнтокшисько-Вінницької Академії Молодих Лідерів» в межах партнерської Угоди про співробітництво між Вінницькою обласною державною адміністрацією та Сьвєнтокшиським воєводством (Республіки Польща).

Ідея даного молодіжного обміну полягає в тому, щоб об'єднати активну молодь з м.Вінниці та м.Кельце, а також інших маленьких містечок відповідних регіонів. Учасники - представники різних громадських організацій, переважно студенти та такі ж самі молоді люди з Польщі.

Наші представники Olya Kazakova та Mykhailo Fedoras теж там були, і з гордістю представляли ГО "Центр розвитку Пангея Ультіма", а крім того провели декілька днів у цікавих подорожах по Польському краю із незабутніми зустрічами та пригодами).

Під час обміну відбулись візити та знайомство з маршалком Сьвєнтокшиського воєводства Adam Jarubasта мером міста і гміни Піньчов Влоджімежом Бадураком, в Центр волонтеріату, з молодіжними радами міст Стараховіце і Вонхоцк, з центром активістів Świetlica Aktywator сьвєнтокшиськими скаутами, неурядовою організацією Fundacja CampoSfera в Сенджішуві, організації "Kalejdoskop" та молодіжними ініціативами, реалізованими Піньчовським самоврядним центром культури. Також познайомились з організаторами Sabat Fiction-Fest, одного з найбліьших фестивалів для молоді про фантастику, ігри, аніме.
А ще, був проведений тренінг на тему лідерства між українськими та польськими учасниками обміну, який продовжиться у травні 2018 р. вже у м.Вінниця.

title: It's up to me 5 TC in Germany (Erasmus +)

data.text: When you imagine the quality of the Erasmus+ K1 youth workers mobility projects here is the live example - "It's up to me" TC for trainers by NaturKultur e.V., Germany. I happened to be a lucky participant of this event that literally changed and advanced my view on things within this great European programme.

Being experienced user of Erasmus Plus mobility both from participant and manager side I was really attentive to details and overall estimation of the process. Eventually I spent a week under Bremen in Kultur Haus on one gasp, whirled in the flow of "It's Up To Me 5". This was an intense experience, that let me face my limits, self-examine myself, uncover the realm of a youth trainer from many sides.

This was done thanks to a beautiful and very talented team of trainers Antonio Jovanovski, Jim Kleiber, Dagna Gmitrowicz, Aleksandra Stojanovska headed by Darko Mitevski and thanks to all other participants that joined the TC representing close to a ten of different countries.

It was felt that the organizers crystallized their expertise in holding this TC through enormous amount of previous stages and delivered their best, captured the participants with jumping energetic levels, creative workshops and what was the most effective - own sincerity, passion and care to the work they do. The best lesson on how to be a trainer in youth field is my own assessment of an experience I lived through on this TC as a student. And the most inspirational conclusion for me was - that no matter how well a youth trainer can be equipped in own methodological approach, with instruments and etc. in the end everything runs down to a personality he/she is. Because youth work is about empowerment, youth work is about example, youth work is about truth. And what can be taken from those people who live their work, who open their heart to thirsty for knowledge and searching own individuality youngsters? This is the best beacon that conquers young minds. And this was the case of "It's up to me 5".

"It's up to me 5" came to me in a highly appropriate moment. When I should sit down and (re)evaluate the past achievements, shape out the plan for future, rethink and gather together for a new bout. This was a real eyeopener, this is a prologue to a new chapter and I wish to carry on the energy of "It's up to me 5" on and on.

I'm grateful to all those youth leaders and enormous personalities I met on this event, I'm grateful to Natur Kultur, trainers, Erasmus Plus and my support circle back home who wake up each day to a thought of becoming better, making better for others and live the dreams. And it's very valuable in this shaky world now.
Iaroslav Gerashchenko
#Erasmusplus #itsuptome #Naturkultur
Mixing up: Volunteer from the Netherlands conducts creative classes in English

Every Monday in the creative space Level 80 at 18:30, the first and so far the only ones in Vinnytsia, classes on creativity for adults are held. The highlight of the club is that the classes are held in English by the volunteer from the Netherlands.

In the creative space Level 80 the first four classes have passed, on them the visitors drew in an unusual way, created applications from recycled materials and experimented with their creativeness in the genre of installation. The Mix Up Club's motto - fantasize, play, learn!

Mix Up is a combination by a creative circle realized through a spoken English language. Within one and a half hours all those who want to have the possibility to train their colloquial skills, learn new English words, master own creativity and, of course, entertain and find friends are invited.

The idea of ​​creating such a club came from the volunteer from the Netherlands, Maud Vosters. Maud came to Ukraine under the Volunteer Cultural Exchange Program. She's very recently in Vinnytsia, but she has been already actively involved in the public life of the city. The girl teaches the Dutch language, takes part in the creation of a film about Vinnytsia artists and in addition, organizes creative evenings in newly created club Mix Up.

The goal of the Mix Up club, - says the author and the leader of workshops Maud Vosters, - to give to each participant to step out of the comfort zone through the process of self-expression, the development of communicative skills, work in a team or own initiative. No evaluation or critical evaluation of the work - the main thing of the tasks - to see how diverse is the solution can come from each person. We communicate and embody our fantasies in a variety of ways: drawing, sculpting, application, audio and video practice, all that will do the creative process of the original and exciting, - shares Maud.

Maud Vosters's creative initiatives quickly came true and began to work in Vinnytsia thanks to many activists of the Vinnytsia community: first of all the “Pangeya Ultima” and “Nashe Podillia” non-governmental organizations and its coordinator Iaroslav Gerashchenko. "We are happy to promote the development of the city, attract volunteers from different countries countries: France, Italy, Germany, the Netherlands to implement a variety of projects, "- says Iaroslav Gerashchenko. VinSmart Clubs leader Dmitry Myra has provided the premises and all the necessary resources, and for all those wish to visit the club it’s absolutely free. Friendly team of volunteers of "Pangeya Ultima" and “Nashe Podillia” helps with the organization the process of creative initiatives.
All those who wish to visit the club need only bring some creative materials for classes. The organizers announce the subject and the necessary materials in the Facebook group
https://www.facebook.com/groups/679203919136983/about/

Creative workshops is a very popular kind of leisure not only among young people, but as well among adults and people of respectable age, because here you can feel secure, playful children who can "create" everything they want. The club does not have any tough rules and restrictions, each participant during the class can join the general lesson topic, or simply listen, or to offer their leisure ideas. Creativity begins where there is no boundaries, so Mix Up is a democratic place for anyone who wants to communicate in English and dive in the world of creativity, - says the curator-volunteer Anna Denysenko.

The Mix Up Club's motto - fantasize, play, learn! We invite all the Vinnytsia citizens and guests of the city to the creative Club every Monday at 18:30 in the Creative Space Level 80 for classes with spoken English and a creative workshops. Follow the announcements and join the Facebook community:
https://www.facebook.com/groups/679203919136983/about/

Привіт усім!

Мене звати Катя, і мені 22 роки. Я з міста Чернівці. Приймаю участь в програмі «Erasmus+Jugend in Aktion» в Потсдамі. Це дуже гарне місто в Німеччині. Я дуже вдячна центру «Пангея Ультіма» в Вінниці за допомогу та підтримку. Я волонтер в дитсадку, досвід з дітками в мене не малий тому працюю легко та із задоволенням.

Німці та їхнє середовище. Дуже багато чого мені тут до вподоби. Деякі речі тут просто інакші, не для порівняння. Всі звичайно знають про ці рівні та чисті дороги, пунктуальність та ті переваги для хорошого життя. Частіше зустрічаються люди щасливі, чи просто задоволені, привітні з посмішкою.

Садочки тут цікаві, завжди є детально продумана програма на кожен день. Все для розвитку дітей, спорт і творчість, математика і природа. Садочки добре профінансовані, професійне нове хороше обладнання для зручної роботи з дітками.

Про мої будні. Зараз вже весна, то я з радістю їду в садок на велосипеді. Потсдам – місто для велосипедистів, зручно, швидко і корисно. Робочий час з пів дев’ятої. З першу в нас «Ранкове коло», ми вітаємося, співаємо та танцюємо, розказуємо про теми дня. Іноді розказую щось і я, вже дещо моя група про Україну знає, та навіть до п’яти рахує. Дуже навіть приємно чути з їхніх уст щось українською.

До речі в моїй групі діти чотирьох та п’яти років. Але допомагаю я повсюди де це потрібно. До години так одинадцятої, діти займаються танцями, музикою, спортом, англійською дехто, зрозуміло це все розписано по днях, і проводимо годину ще на подвір’ї.

Мій садок знаходиться на окраїні міста, на свіжому повітрі, з гарною природою, лісом. А ще поряд ферма, багато тварин, дуже цікаво. Об одинадцятій ми готуємося до обіду, до речі годують смачно, та потім дітки вкладаються на розстелені мною матраци, я читаю казочку, і вони сплять.

Тиха година триває з 12 до 14, я виконую якісь поставленні переді мною прохання, щось малюю, вирізаю, пишу чи складаю. Я такий собі «подай-принеси», але я не проти, мені то навіть в кайф. Після сну діти мають підвечірок. Я приношу їжу, потім складаю постіль на місця, діти одягаються на вулицю, я прибираю столики після того як малі поїли. Потім забираю посуд на кухню, мені приносять ще посуд з інших груп, я запаковую це все в посудомийку, великі посудини мию вручну. Потім складаю вимитий посуд по місцях.

І ось вже настала година, коли я закінчила свій робочий час, опів на четверту я їду додому. Додому - це в гуртожиток. В моєму випадку, це квартира на п’ятьох волонтерів. Цікаво і весело, так як всі з різних країн. Мені дісталась простора, світла кімната з міні-балконом з чудом видом.

Гроші на харчування та особисті потреби – це сім і чотири євро, разом одинадцять на добу. Якщо харчуватися самостійно без відвідувань кафе та інших закладів, то вистачає. Можна навіть зібрати деяку суму на подорож, і відвідати декілька міст.

Дуже мені тут подобається, це класний і корисний досвід для кожного. Я щаслива робити, те що я роблю. Розказувати можна багато чого, але ви краще спробуйте самі тому, що це краще прожити самостійно. Вибирайте країну і гайда набиратися досвіду!

title: Study visit to Moldova "Youth work in rural areas" (Erasmus+)

data.text: The previous week 28.5-3.6 I spent closely connected with our southern neighbor - Moldova. It was an intense period of exploration, acquaintances, making friendship and, very often, admiration.

I was lucky to be a participant of the study visit to Moldova "Youth work in rural areas" organized by SALTO Eastern Europe and Caucasus in partnership with ADVIT Moldova. The organizers compiled a range of active CSOs, state youth centers and organized meetings with interesting people who are involved in youth work in Moldova, especially the one that is going on in rural area.

From this experience me personally bring out many practical knowledge, examples and inspiration for own activity. I really admit that Moldovans have achieved considerable success in certain sectors of youth work. Especially this concerns the recognition of voluntary activity by young people, legal basis (e.g. on social entrepreneurship) and structure of youth centers. Ukraine has to take lessons out of them, especially as the context is pretty similar.
The study visit presented to us social entrepreneurs, eco-activists, youth banks, health educators and human rights activists operating in the province.

Together with the professional field this trip uncovered to me the beauty of this small country. In 6 days of the event I managed to get diverse cultural experiences that included crossing the Dnister border on a tow-raft, visiting the biggest vine cellar in the world Milestii Mici, ancient cave monasteries near Orhei (Orheiul Vechi), staying at luxurious hotels in Chisinau and walking across their lovely central park, reaching to the multiethnic Gagauzia, relaxing at charming Hanul lui Hanganu agro-estate and travelling back home through interesting Transnistria.

I'm grateful for all the sharing moments with those who I happened to meet on the way during this Study Visit, to organizers for their diligent logistics, facilitation and Erasmus+ insights (Marina Capatina, Max Pijevskii, Małgorzata Pawłowska, Paavo Furius Pyykkönen) and to all activists from the hosting sites that we have visited! Wish you all energy and inspiration in your effort to change this world to better.

Цієї суботи в Кінотеатр Родина було людно – проводилась вже втретє традиційна для молодіжного медійного проекту YouthInsight подія – фестиваль аматорського відео-виробництва. Фестиваль зібрав під одним дахом любителів аматорського відео та фото, аматорських театралів, музик та багато інших позитивних та веселих людей із різних країн Європи. Якщо точно, то у «Родину» завітали молодь із близько вісьми країн Європи, котрі розчинились в атмосфері затишного спілкування, гумору, творчості та відео-експерименталістики.

Дехто із учасників фестиваля мав особливу роль – вони представляли свої напрацювання протягом перебування на проекті Європейської Волонтерської Служби програми Еразсмус + “Youthinsight”. А саме це були Фабіо Оссола, Фрідеріке Вюрст, Антоніо Пічерні та Мауд Востерс, котрим допомагала супервайзер проекту Надія Шевченко. Вони представляли свій погляд на речі і людей, які оточують нас.

Також в програмі яскравим компонентом були аматорсоькі театралізовані міні-перфоменси від театру Movers & Shakers із учасниками Марія Геращенко, Ніко Катцльбергер, Дафні Говрі та Мауд Востерс. Звучала і пісня: розпочався захід виступом дуету Женя і Катя, котрих дуже любить місцева пубіка, а в перерві «на каву» Ніко Катцльбергер взявся за гітару та джемив із Yurii Bilous.

В другій половині заходу місцеві аматори відео-любителі мали змогу показати свої роботи і ми побачили багато цікавого: відео на тему Вінниці, подорожей, жіночності, і, навіть, анімація – все це радувало око відвідувачів фестивалю. Особливо класний і естетично якісний доробок привезла із Києва хороший друг фествиалю Nika Popova.

Також в холі кінотеатру Антоніо Пічерні та Фрідеріке Вюрст керували фото-виставкою свого Photo Club in Vinnytsia. Ну і не можливо не згадати і подякувати ведучому вечору – Кирилл Бережнов за відповідальне проведення та намагання зробити цей вечір святом гумору також!

Ось уже із 2014 четвертий цикл проекту YouthInsight відбуваєтсья у Вінниці. На нього приїздять активні та креативні молоді волонтери із країн Європи. Цикл 2017-18 років не є виключенням з правилу – усі йього учасники повезуть додому багато гарних історій про Україну, застосовуватимуть свої здобуті навики та завжди памятатимуть тих друзів, котрих вони знайшли разом із кмандами ГО «Наше Поділля» та ГО «Центр розвитку Пангея Ультіма».
Проект Youthinsight це приклад проекту із методологічним наповненням неформальної освіти, але який лишає слід у громаді.

P.S.: Проект Youthinsight 2017-18 продожвуватиметсья ще до кінця вересня для двох волонтерів ЄВС - Антоніо Пічерні та Мауд Востерс, тому запрошуємо вас на їх заходи, що вони проводять для місцевих жителів – клуб нідерландської мови та клуб італійської мови.

This Saturday the “Rodyna” cinema of Vinnytsia was crowded as the third, now traditional, culminating meeting within the “Youthinsight” project was held which is titled – the Festival of amateur media production. The festival has gathered under one roof the fans of amateur audio and visual production, amateur theater, musicians and many more other positive and joyful people from different countries of Europe. If to be precise the “Rodyna” that evening was visited by about 8 nationalities from the countries of Europe who dissolved in the atmosphere of cozy communication, humor, art and video-experimentalism.

Some participants from the festival had a special role – they presented own material produced during their activity as the volunteers of the European Voluntary Service of the Erasmus+ in the “Youthinsight” project. To be precise these were – Fabio Ossola, Lis Bo (Friederike Wurst), Antonio Picerni and Maud Vosters who were aided by their supervisor Надежда Шевченко. They presented own perspective on things and people around.

As well the bright component of the evening were the mini-performances of the Movers and Shakers - English Amateur Theatre with its members Mary Gerashchenko Malogolovchuk, Niko Katzlberger, Daphy Duck and Maud Vosters.

Music side was provided by the highly esteemed local duo "Zhenia & Katia" and during the coffee break Niko Katzlberger jammed with Yuri Bilous. The second half of the event saw the local amateur video-producers demonstrating own works and we have watched many interesting material: from the video about Vinnytsia, travelling, women’s beauty to even animation – these all topics have cheered up the visitors.

Especially cool and aesthetically advanced were the works brought in from Kyiv by the close friend of the festival Nika Popova. As well in the hall of the cinema the “Photo Club in Vinnytsia” was exhibiting best photos.
And we cannot not mention and say thanks to the leader of the event – Kiril Berezhnov for the responsible moderation and effort to make the evening as well the holiday of humour!

Altogether it is the fourth project cycle of the “Youthinsight” since 2014 that is held in Vinnytsia. It is visited by the active and creative young volunteers from the European countries. The 2017-18 cycle is not an exception from the rule – all its participants will bring home many great stories to tell about Ukraine, will utilize the attained skills and will always remember friends that they have made together with the NGO Nashe Podillya / Наше Поділля and NGO Development center Pangeya Ultima.
The “Youthinsight” project is an example of the non-formal education methodology that leaves traces in the hosting community.

P.S.: The “Youthinsight” 20171-18 project will continue till the end of September for the two EVS volunteers – Antonio Picerni and Maud Vosters. Therefore we invite you to the events that they conduct for the local citizens – the Dutch Club in Vinnytsia and the Italian Club in Vinnytsia.

title: Impulse Boost Camp 2108 (Germany) by Tatiana Baranova

data.text: Would you ever believe that one week can change your life?
The only thing you need for it is the "Impulse Boost Camp" and your heart and soul open for new challenges and ideas :)

I'm thankful for the chance to experience IBC and spend a wonderful week in Schneeberg, with a group of extraordinarily talanted, inspiring, energetic people, who are not indifferent to the problems of our society, who care for other people and our world on the whole.

Sometimes we think that nobody can understand OUR problems, cause they're so unique and special, but the truth is, we are all the same and we have "brothers and sisters" all over the world, without even being aware of that. For example, I would never have thought that Tunisia is soo much alike to Ukraine and in spite of all differences in religion, language and traditions, we have the same worries both in politics and everyday life. Or that Turkish people complain about exactly the same things we do. The list can be continued, but the idea is that wherever you are from: Germany, Romania, Scotland, Tunisia, Turkey or Ukraine, you have to stay HUMAN and respect other people. That's what these meetings are for - to open our eyes and break the borders in our minds.
P.S. A huge Thank You to IBC and Pangeya Ultima for giving me a chance to break mine:)

From 8 till 21 July Eco-Center in Stina / Еко-центр у Стіні hosted a work camp Image Mapping 2018. This time the project has walked away from the usual format as the Development center Pangeya Ultima / Центр розвитку Пангея Ультіма is a partner together with the Nashe Podillya / Наше Поділля in the development of the center itself.

That is why the working programme was composed partly of the objectives of the Image Mapping while the hefty part of that was dedicated to the infrastructural activities around the territory of the center.

Through this work the volunteers were introduced to the traditional ways of coating the house, construction of the stone stairs and construction of the wooden toilets and showers. As a tradition the volunteers have as well created the “Alive picture” in Село Стіна або "маленькі Карпати" that now stands out on the steep Stina canyon slope focusing the visitors onto the Castle Hill. In frames of the Image Mapping aim of revitalizing the social dynamics of the rural communities the camp has hosted the concert of the French garage rock band BROK, international project.
The partners of the “Image Mapping 2018” camp were: Erasmus+ and akzente Salzburg, Initiativen für junge Leute(Austria), Internationaler Bauorden (Germany), Archiclub / Vinnytsia(Vinnytsia).

The camp has become the challenge for its participants as it was apparently the first so much intense with physical tasks camp among all of the former camps realized by the DC Pangeya Ultima. There was so much work around the territory of the Eco-center that some of the objectives had to be dropped and improvised on.

But only thanks to the enormous productivity, dedication and extraordinary great internal spirit of the team of the volunteers it became manageable. With great pride we can assert that we have achieved really considerable results. Now the Eco-center in Stina has acquired two summer showers, two eco-toilets, the hut was bleached, supported with concrete and it got painted with love from the participants and the local children.

We are grateful to the Archiclub for the planning of the new wooden constructions of the Eco-center, especially to Maksym Kramar who looked like a genius scientist with his 3D-modelled ideas of the building on the territory of the center. All volunteers have acquired intense practical experience, learned own capabilities and proof-checked traits of character that show up in the working process during the living in simple conditions with the same minded people.

The special moment of the camp was the gig of the French garage rock band "Brok” that came in Стіна in frames of their Ukrainian tour with the organization from the ever dedicated former EVS volunteer Noémie Philippe-Dumestier. Guys have made the real rock with crazy dances in the local house of culture, together with the performance from the local art ensemble and exchange of positive vibes between all the participants. We are sincerely grateful to Noemie and Brok for the night and we wish successful coming gigs in Ukraine.

As well there were stars, communication till early morning around the camp-fire, heavy rains, pasta by Italian recipe from the fire, pleasure pf communication with the local people, plums, milk, cats and smiles. The biggest adventurers among the participants as well used the chance to visitBusha and the “Image Mapping” route of “Alive pictures” 2015, and Sorocaacross the Dnister River in the bordering Republic of Moldova and had a windy ride down the Stina entry slope on the truck basket.

We are grateful for the best and most productive atmosphere for all the volunteers who have arrived to the camp charged for the result, dedicated to the vision of the center, to own projects and ever searching for adventures: Sabine Manhartsberger, Olka Smile, Maksym Kramar, Piotr Kujawski, Maud Vosters, Daphy Duck, Antonio Picerni, Angelina Chiriban, Katia Zayets, Masha Yuzkova, Bogdan Martynets, Niko Katzlberger, Igor Strelkov, Fabio Ossola, Iaroslav Gerashchenko, Yuriy Stepanets and Olga Nagirniak.

Our Image Mapping project continues and prepares to visit many new communities where adventures, challenges and frank exchange between the volunteers and the local population await us. And this 2018 project will remain a special page in the history of the project as it is a huge luck to see people work with so much love how it was in Stina.

title: Image Mapping camp memories by Niko

data.text: “We will build shower and toilet!” was the main answer I, Nikolaus Katzlberger, EVS volunteer in Ukriane, told my people when they asked me about what we will do during the work camp. Of course it was not just this, it took us the biggest effort, though.

Everything started on a Saturday morning near the office of Pangeya Ultima, where we gathered people and stuff for the bus ride to a little village called Stina. In this village, we decided to live for the next 15 days – in tents, without running water and (at the beginning) without internet connection.
This was already the first challenge for some people who have never ever slept in a tent before. But I can tell you now that everything was fine.

As soon as we arrived, we organized ourselves, set up the tents and discussed the schedule of the following days. Besides the famous construction of toilet and shower, this schedule included the building of staircases, the renovation and painting of the house, flattening the territory and last but definitely not least the manufacture of the Alive Picture for the Image Mapping route.

Needless to say, we also had to survive somehow which logically leads to the additional activity of cooking (and cleaning). Furthermore, a concert of the French rock band “Brok” was planned to take place in the second week of our stay.

It was some hard work, I can tell you. It took us 3 sudatory days to prepare the ground for our constructions, just with shovels and spades. We had to carry a lot of heavy rocks, prepare material for the fundaments, and prepare the wood – with a handsaw and an axe. However, we had quite a lot of fun and I can say from my side that I really enjoyed this period. Our work was also made a bit more diverse by activities like renovating the windows of our house with the excrements of horses. You don’t believe me? There is even an interview with our French girl Daphnée who explains how it works!

Speaking of French people, in the middle of the second week Brok played their concert in the village’s house of culture. They actually arrived a few days earlier already, but suddenly escaped again because we let them work hard with us.
Unfortunately, not everyone could attend the concert from our side, as a few people had to leave after the first week already. Nevertheless, new people arrived, so our group didn’t shrink too much.

Anyways, the concert was super cool! We had a lot of fun (some of us also a lot of alcohol which was immediately punished on the next day by a heavy headache) and a lot of troubles with the electricity. The band had to stop the concert earlier, but the time they played was enough to make my t-shirt completely wet of sweat and to let local people, of which there was a lot surprisingly, enjoy their music. It was a great evening!

The last days, we had to struggle a bit. We were tired after the concert, maybe we spent too much time 24/7 all together at the same place, and also the work seemed to be endless. In the end, we managed to finish everything according to what we resolved to do, as well as not killing each other after those long 2 weeks. Shower and toilet dominated the camp – but actually it was so much more!
A big thank you to everyone who participated!
Niko Katzlberger

title: Impulse Boost Camp 2018: “Ideas grow by sharing”

data.text: “Somehow this was a life changing experience”, Sarah Ben Hsouna sighted emotionally, “in
a good direction of course!” The young woman from Tunisia was one of the 18 participants of
Impulse Boost Camp 2018, a nine-day long international multiplier seminar that took place from
July 7th to 15th in Schneeberg, Germany.
Sarah works as a multiplier in Tunisia and Libya. She
hosts her own radio show on which she talks about today’s obstacles and opportunities in Tunisia.
As a voluntary job at the side, she organizes events for different Tunisian NGOs. In Libya, a
country that did not get out of the Arab Spring as well as Tunisia, she organizes workshops on
democracy for young women.
“From IBC I take with me a huge piece of luggage with new useful
knowledge, skills, method and project ideas that I will use for my work back at home”, she
concludes. Franz Knoppe, project coordinator and trainer at IBC, nods happily: “This is exactly
what we are aiming to achieve. Instead of sending white people from Germany to transforming
countries, we empower young multipliers that are active in civil society.”
The multicultural mix out of participants coming from Turkey, Ukraine, Romania, Tunisia,
Scotland and Germany facilitated the learning process. “I would have never thought that Ukraine
and Tunisia have so much in common”, laughed Sarah. IBC focuses on passing on soft skills that
make voluntary work more effective and harmonic, such as team moderation, presenting or
nonviolent communication. As a second pillar the participants get to know methods that can be
used for the implementation of their own projects. Sessions on personal development are also part
of the programme as well as an excursion to Leipzig, where this year’s participants got to know
initiatives of coming to terms with the history of Germany. “Every year the programme differs”,
Franz Knoppe explains, “this year we invited external guest speakers for some workshops and
extended the programme by one day.”
IBC is a cooperational project between the German foundation ifzw impulsstiftung and the
organization ASA-FF e.V. In addition, participants from 5 different partner organisations profit from
training. IBC takes place once a year since 2016 and is a result of the evolution of the preceding
project “fit for the future”. And what is the conclusion from the side of the organizer? Franz Knoppe:
“I saw how ideas grew by sharing. I think it was our best seminar so far.”
Other statements about IBC 2018 from participants
“an amazing mix of input, reflexion, inspiration, time for exchange, practice and discussion”
“a super appreciative, curious atmosphere”
“beautifully hearted people that openly shared their stories”
“well-organised and useful workshops with inspiring speakers”
